title: Cost Saving Agent
subtitle: Three specialized AI agents, built on the same reusable ReAct engine, that analyze real spend data and propose verifiable recommendations.

cost_saving.label: Cost Saving
cost_saving.description: Analyzes real spend (suppliers, anomalies, contracts) and proposes verifiable savings opportunities, not made-up numbers.

forecast.label: Forecast
forecast.description: Projects next month's spend from the real historical trend (linear regression).

contract_risk.label: Contract Risk
contract_risk.description: Searches indexed contracts for risky clauses — penalties, exclusivity, missing price caps.

noRecommendations: No opportunities found in the current data.
